description.en: Complete authentic FFV bestiary (360 enemies) with stats from the SNES data as compiled by FFSKY. Includes world grouping, per-area locations, weaknesses, steal/drop lists and rare steals. Regular enemies are ordered by in-game progression; bosses are split by world with forms kept.
description.pt-BR: Bestiario completo e autentico de FFV (360 inimigos) com stats do dados SNES compilados pelo FFSKY. Inclui agrupamento por mundo, localizacao por area, fraquezas, itens de steal/drop e steal raro. Inimigos regulares em ordem de progressao; chefes separados por mundo com formas preservadas.
